description: Four bands following Zurich Airport's own published North/East/South concept windows (docs/LSZH_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md). Zurich's real published hours differ on weekends/Baden-Württemberg holidays (e.g. North 09:00-20:00 instead of 07:00-21:00) but the engine does not yet support day-of-week rules (docs/TIME_BASED_RULES.md, TB-4) -- this plan uses the weekday hours as the only set of bands, a known simplification, not a data error. The overnight 23:30-06:00 period is covered by the East-concept mode rather than a dedicated curfew band, matching the project's own precedent of not modelling curfews as a special rule (YSSY). A mode with no row in a band keeps the pack's default preference penalty and stays allowed, so wind can still override these preferences if it must (soft preference, hard eligibility).
